== Summary ==
Lossless two-page extract of the complete official Set 9 PDF [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193358id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-9.pdf archived at 2021-10-05T19:33:58Z]. Extract pages 1 and 2 correspond to original pages 1 and 6. Original PDF SHA-256 <code>1a4a0ce08ac504a5cfe79b59c43c62f076af76b1c0014bcf4525bd39603dcb98</code>, 123,968,985 bytes, seven pages. The original exceeds the Wiki upload limit. Exact extracted text, page rectangles and complete composed page pixels match the original. No rasterization or lossy recompression is introduced. The archive capture dates this copy, not the unknown first-publication day. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
